title: Camera Subsystem Dynamic Attributes
description: Dynamic attributes of the camera, defining the mounting position and aim output targets.

definition.description: Resource location of the subsystem model, pointing to the corresponding subsystem static attribute definition file.

locator.description: Camera mount locator name, the bone in the model serves as the camera position.

aim_output_targets.description: Aim point output channel and targets, sending ViewInputSignal to the specified channels.
